description:
Operating Area: Italy

Azimut Fly 82 EXPLORA is a luxury yacht that redefines the way guests experience the sea, blending dynamic lines and contemporary elegance with the warm, inviting spirit of the Fly Series. Her refined exterior design and meticulously crafted interiors offer generous volumes, complete privacy, and stunning panoramic views through expansive windows, making her an exceptional choice for luxury yacht charters.

The interiors by Fabio Fantolino feature a sophisticated interplay of premium materials: warm and cool tones, matte and glossy finishes, bold architectural accents and subtle refined details. Every space is designed to impress guests, creating a perfect balance between relaxing comfort and social enjoyment on board.

The innovative Deck2Deck™ system extends the aft platform, transforming it into a spacious terrace over the water and enhancing the open-air lifestyle that defines the Azimut Fly 82 EXPLORA. The exterior lines sculpted by Alberto Mancini appear shaped by the wind, giving the yacht a sense of fluid movement even when at rest.

The night area is thoughtfully arranged to ensure comfort and privacy for all guests, featuring 1 full-beam Master cabin, 1 VIP cabin, 1 Double cabin, and 1 Twin cabin with two single beds. Each cabin offers refined materials, soft lighting, and elegant detailing, providing a serene retreat during any charter vacation.

A professional crew of 4 experienced members is on board to ensure exceptional service and a seamless luxury charter experience. For maximum comfort at sea, Azimut Fly 82 EXPLORA is equipped with stabilizers both at anchor and underway, minimizing roll and delivering smooth cruising in all sea conditions.

With her innovative design, premium craftsmanship, and outstanding comfort, Azimut Fly 82 EXPLORA is a luxury yacht that celebrates the beauty of the sea in every detail, offering an immersive and prestigious charter experience.

crew.name: ALESSANDRO D'AMICO
crew.bio:
NATIONALITY
ITALIAN

Captain Alessandro is a professional with an established career cruising the Mediterranean, including some of its most sought-after destinations such as the Amalfi Coast, Capri, and Costa Smeralda. His in-depth local knowledge allows him to craft well-balanced itineraries that combine iconic anchorages with quieter, off-the-radar spots, always tailored to guests’ preferences. Known for his calm and composed leadership style, Captain Alessandro places the highest priority on safety, operational excellence, and discretion. He leads his crew with clarity and respect,
ensuring smooth day-to-day operations and a
consistently high standard of service on
board. With a strong focus on personalized
service and seamless coordination, Captain
Alessandro is dedicated to delivering a
bespoke charter experience where guests can
feel completely at ease, confident that every
detail of their time aboard EXPLORA is
handled with professionalism and care.

crew.name: MATTEO UCCIARDELLO
crew.bio:
NATIONALITY
ITALIAN

Chef Matteo Ucciardello brings a solid fine dining background to EXPLORA, with professional experience gained in prestigious kitchens including the Four Seasons San Domenico Palace in Taormina and the Michelin-starred restaurant Accursio in Modica. His training in high-end restaurants is reflected in a refined, detail-oriented approach and a strong respect for quality
ingredients. On board, Chef Matteo specializes in Mediterranean and international cuisine, creating menus that are fully tailored to guest preferences, dietary requirements, and special occasions. His cooking style balances elegance and flavor, combining thoughtful presentation with well-judged textures and harmony of tastes. With a passion for fresh, seasonal produce and a commitment to consistency at the highest level, Chef Matteo delivers a sophisticated gastronomic experience that enhances every charter, whether for relaxed family dining or formal,
celebratory meals.

crew.name: KRYSTELLE LAYUNG
crew.bio:
NATIONALITY
FILIPINO

Krystelle provides professional, attentive, and discreet service throughout the charter, ensuring guests feel comfortable and well cared for at all times. With a natural sense of hospitality and a calm, approachable manner, she contributes to a welcoming and relaxed onboard environment. Highly detail-oriented, Krystelle takes great pride in the yacht’s presentation, maintaining elegant interiors and thoughtfully prepared guest areas. Her attentiveness and consistency help create a seamless onboard experience, supporting the crew in delivering a refined and enjoyable
charter aboard EXPLORA.

crew.name: RYMON CANDIA
crew.bio:
NATIONALITY
FILIPINO

Rymond is a reliable deckhand responsible for deck operations, tender handling, and the
general maintenance of EXPLORA. With a proactive and hands-on approach, he supports the Captain during maneuvers and ensures that all exterior areas are kept in excellent condition. Approachable and collaborative, Rymond is always ready to assist guests, particularly during water activities, helping to create a safe and enjoyable experience on the water. His professionalism and attention to detail contribute to smooth daily operations and a well-organized, relaxed atmosphere on board.
